annotation.title_clean: Kecerdasan Buatan Dan Tantangan Regulasi Di Indonesia: Antara Inovasi Dan Ketidakpastian Hukum
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence and Regulatory Challenges in Indonesia: Between Innovation and Legal Uncertainty
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Badan Pembinaan Hukum Nasional (BPHN), Jurnal Rechtsvinding
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Opinion article in Jurnal Rechtsvinding on Indonesia's AI regulatory gaps. It reviews the ITE and Personal Data Protection laws, notes there is no AI-specific law, and urges technology-neutral, principle-based regulation (OECD, UNESCO), clear liability rules, algorithmic transparency and non-discrimination.
key_provisions_or_claims: Indonesia has no law specifically regulating AI standards, audits and liability.
Recommends adaptive, technology-neutral, principle-based regulation drawing on OECD and UNESCO principles.
Liability for AI harm is unclear under Article 1365 of the Civil Code.
Suggests considering limited legal status for AI systems.
Calls for algorithmic transparency standards, non-discrimination and public-private participation.
